prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_screen], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] is mixed: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed: one test won (+5.5% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] is mixed: one test was stopped early (-8.4% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (+0.8% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, though round 11 was an exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +4.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 79.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Path Selection Split Showcase: Redesign the path selection screen into a split layout showcasing companion path choices and preview outcomes. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation during initial path selection.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Cloud Sync Safety Guarantee: Add clear copy guaranteeing cloud saving so users know their pets will never reset upon signing in again. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Progress Interactive Flow: Rebuild the waiting screen with an animated progress visualization and interactive tips during rendering. (why: The home waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing drop-off or uncertainty while waiting for generation.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Placement and Control Hub Redesign: Redesign the home introduction screen into a stage layout detailing desktop pet controls and visibility shortcuts. (why: Support receives recurrent tickets regarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Staging Notification Banner: Add a prominent connection hint banner on sign-in reassuring users if auth takes a few seconds. (why: Support tickets noted sign-in screen delays or stalling before authentication loads.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Estimated Time Display: Enable visual time estimation and readiness notification alerts on the pet preparation waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time on the waiting screen reaches 2336 seconds, causing users to abandon the app thinking it froze.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding Journey Time Estimate Hint: Show a quick time estimate hint on the path selection screen so users know onboarding takes under 3 minutes. (why: The choose_path screen mean duration is 514s despite median 8s, indicating some users stall without clear duration expectations.)
